title: The Saturday Repair Bench
transcript: Come on in and find a seat if this is your first visit to the repair workshop. When you're ready, take a paper tag from the desk and write your name on it. Tie it to whatever you've brought, so we can find you if we need to ask about it. If there's any chance of oil dripping from your item, leave it on the rubber mat near the door. The rest can go on the low shelves while you wait. We've put out a parts tray at each bench for screws and other little pieces that might roll away. When a volunteer calls you over, pull up a chair. We ask you to stay with your item while it's being worked on so you can see what's done. Before leaving, please tell the person at the desk whether you got it working again.

questions.prompt: Label to attach to each item: paper ____
questions.explanation: 来访者要在纸标签上写下姓名，再把标签系在带来的物品上。

questions.prompt: Place for items that might drip oil: rubber ____
questions.explanation: 可能滴油的物品要放在门边的橡胶垫上。

questions.prompt: Container for screws at each bench: parts ____
questions.explanation: 每张工作台都备有零件托盘，用来放螺丝等小物件。

questions.prompt: What should visitors do during the repair?
options: Stay nearby and watch the work.
Wait at the entrance until called again.
questions.answer: Stay nearby and watch the work.
questions.explanation: 讲话者请来访者在维修期间留在物品旁边，看看志愿者如何操作。

questions.prompt: What should visitors report before leaving?
options: How they heard about the workshop
questions.explanation: 离开前，来访者要告诉服务台物品是否恢复了正常使用。
